english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for fastening something with string or rope.
This is the all-purpose choice for tying or fastening something tightly.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for fastening or securing someone or something with a strap or similar tie.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb for attaching, tying, or fastening one thing to another.

examples.english: I use a rope to tie the cardboard box shut.

examples.english: I bind the box tightly with a rope.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 tiu4 sing4 bong2 sat6 go3 soeng1

examples.traditional: 我用繩將張蓆綁喺架車頂。
